name: The signed-in competitor

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('id', id, 'handle', handle, 'role', role)::text AS body FROM users WHERE id = ($1)::uuid

description: The body column is cast to text and parsed back by a parse_json task: Orion's db_read goes through sqlx's Any driver, which cannot decode the Postgres json/jsonb type and fails the task outright. Casting keeps response construction in SQL -- see README 'Postgres builds the response JSON' -- at the cost of one extra task.
